scope_note: A new section in the coverage-completion round the repository owner authorised on 2026-09-14 (audits/coverage/2026-09-14/STUDY-GUIDE-COVERAGE-COMPLETION-PLAN.json); no earlier audit binds it. Four planned records were replaced before freezing: MA-CDTM-RETAIL-SCOPE, MA-CDTM-CONTROLLED-LIMIT and MA-CDTM-SVI-RX (a URL form that no longer opens, boilerplate fields, and for SVI-RX an omitted "specifically allows initial prescriptions" condition and a sender the statute does not name) by MA-CDTM-RETAIL-DISEASE-REFERENCE-AND-CONSENT, MA-CDTM-RETAIL-SCHEDULE-II-V-BAR and MA-CDTM-RETAIL-SVI-INITIAL-PRESCRIPTION-CONDITIONS (M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2(c)(5), inserted by St. 2008, c. 528, s. 3); and MA-CDTM-VACCINE-ADMINISTRATION (a "rather than" gloss and a landing-page URL) by MA-CDTM-COMMUNITY-PHARMACY-AGE-AND-VACCINES (247 CMR 16.03(5)(a)-(b), 243 CMR 2.12(4)(e)). MA-CDTM-RETAIL-AGE-EXTENSION stays; MA-CDTM-PRESCRIBING-RETAIL-SVI is cited to hand off to SG-MA-CDTM-PRESCRIBING. Added for in-scope law no record carried: MA-CDTM-COMMUNITY-LIMITED-PRESCRIBING and MA-CDTM-COMMUNITY-SCHEDULE-LIMITS (247 CMR 16.03(5)(e)), MA-CDTM-COMMUNITY-REFERRAL-CONSENT-RECORDS (247 CMR 16.03(5)(c)-(d), 16.04(1), 243 CMR 2.12(4)(e)3-5, the referral and consent formalities SG-MA-CDTM-PRESCRIBING points readers to), MA-CDTM-RETAIL-HEALTH-FACILITY-REGISTRATION-EXEMPTION (s. 24B1/2(d)) and MA-CDTM-REGULATIONS-LIMITED-BY-STATUTE (s. 24B3/4). Where 247 CMR 16.03(5) differs from the statute (extension periods, initiate or discontinue versus modify, co-morbidities) the section teaches both, calls the point arguable because no text says which controls, and gives the course safe on either reading. Scope gate: every signal declined; MA-EMERGENCY-VACCINE-GATE, MA-EMERGENCY-VACCINE-PROTOCOLS and MA-EPT-PRACTITIONER-AUTHORITY share 105 CMR 700.003 but are the emergency vaccine and expedited partner therapy pathways taught elsewhere. Practice links: MA-Q-0082, MA-Q-0083, MA-Q-0084 and MA-Q-0344; MA-Q-0340 and MA-Q-0341 left the links because their explanations overstate the texts.
